PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mechanical Properties of Materials? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mechanical Properties of Materials.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Physics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Physics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Physics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Physics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Physics.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Waves? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Waves.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Waves.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Waves.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Waves.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Temperature and Thermal Expansion? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Temperature and Thermal Expansion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Temperature and Thermal Expansion.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 of 62 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Space Physics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Physics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Pressure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Mechanical Properties of Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
